title: Pakistan Affairs
subtitle: General Knowledge-III · CSS 2026
answerKeyNote: Practice answer key (not an official FPSC key). Review carefully.

questions.text: Article ________ empowers the Supreme Court to enforce Fundamental Rights directly.
questions.explanation: Article 184(3): original jurisdiction for fundamental rights.

questions.text: India has constructed Baglihar Dam on ________ River.
questions.explanation: Baglihar Dam is on the Chenab.

questions.text: Pakistan Army provided training to which Middle Eastern country's armed forces in the 1970s?
questions.explanation: Pakistan helped raise and train UAE forces in the 1970s.

questions.text: Which constitutional amendment generated debate about judicial reforms?
questions.explanation: 26th (2024) and 27th (2025) both restructured the judiciary.

questions.text: Which province introduced a "Green Energy Transition Policy" in 2024?
questions.explanation: Best-effort key.

questions.text: The edited volume "The Future of Pakistan" is authored by:
questions.explanation: Edited by Stephen P. Cohen (Brookings, 2011).

questions.text: The establishment and structure of the Supreme Court is provided under Article ________:
questions.explanation: Part VII, Chapter 2: Articles 176–191.

questions.text: Pakistan joined the International Monetary Fund (IMF) in:
questions.explanation: Pakistan joined the IMF on 11 July 1950.

questions.text: Badshahi Mosque was built by:
questions.explanation: Built by Aurangzeb (1671–73).

questions.text: SAARC was founded in:
questions.explanation: Founded in Dhaka, December 1985.

questions.text: Pakistan's largest solar park is in:
questions.explanation: Quaid-e-Azam Solar Park, Bahawalpur.

questions.text: ________ was the Ottoman Caliph when the Khilafat movement began.
questions.explanation: Mehmed VI (r. 1918–22).

questions.text: Who is the author of the book "Making Sense of Pakistan"?
questions.explanation: Farzana Shaikh (2009).

questions.text: The only Pakistani PM who visited the US and addressed a joint session of Congress is:
questions.explanation: Benazir Bhutto addressed a joint session on 7 June 1989 (Liaquat addressed the two houses separately in 1950).

questions.text: Which Middle Eastern country was the first to recognize Pakistan in 1947?
questions.explanation: Iran was the first country to recognize Pakistan.

questions.text: ________ was the first country to purchase the JF-17 Thunder fighter Jet.
questions.explanation: Myanmar was the first export customer (2015).

questions.text: Which sector is projected to be the primary driver of Pakistan's GDP growth under the latest 5 year plan (2024-29)?
questions.explanation: Best-effort key: services is the largest growth contributor.

questions.text: Which of the following is not included in the '5 Es Framework to Turnaround Pakistan'?
questions.explanation: The 5Es are Exports, E-Pakistan, Environment, Energy, Equity & Empowerment.

questions.text: ________ founded the Khaksar Tehreek.
questions.explanation: Founded by Allama Mashriqi in 1931.

questions.text: Islamabad officially became the capital of Pakistan in:
questions.explanation: Islamabad formally became the capital in 1967.
